summaryOverrides.createBoxPlot: Creates a Box plot owner that defers geometry and guides until compatible x/y roles are available.
summaryOverrides.createGradientPlot: Creates a Gradient plot owner that defers geometry and guides until compatible x/y roles are available.
summaryOverrides.createScatterPlot: Draws one point per observation, without statistical aggregation. Supports color, size, and shape fields; defaults to applicable axes, grid, and legends. Aggregate create-only describes composed actions, not aggregated rows.
summaryOverrides.createPolarScatterPlot: Draws a complete Polar scatter plot that maps observations to angular and radial position while keeping glyph size independent.
summaryOverrides.createPolarLinePlot: Draws a complete Polar line plot that connects angular and radial observations as open or explicitly closed paths.
summaryOverrides.createRadarPlot: Draws a complete Radar plot from long category-value rows or explicitly selected wide fields as closed Polar profiles.
summaryOverrides.createTickMark: Creates short tick glyphs for compact one-dimensional distributions or aligned value marks.
summaryOverrides.encodeAngle: Maps a constant or quantitative field to point or tick rotation angle.
summaryOverrides.editLegendLayout: Edits one legend's position, alignment, direction, columns, title placement, and item spacing.
summaryOverrides.editLegendLabels: Edits the text style of one legend's item labels.
summaryOverrides.editLegendTitle: Edits one legend's title text and title style.
summaryOverrides.editLegendSymbols: Edits one legend's discrete symbols or continuous gradient.
summaryOverrides.editLegendBorder: Adds, removes, or styles the border around one legend.
summaryOverrides.createScale: Creates a named scale that maps a semantic domain to a graphical range.
summaryOverrides.editScale: Partially edits a named or uniquely resolvable scale and rematerializes its consumers.
summaryOverrides.editSemantic: Sets or removes one semantic property inside an extension action.
summaryOverrides.createGraphics: Creates one backend-neutral concrete graphic resource inside an extension action.
summaryOverrides.editGraphics: Sets a concrete graphic property or removes a top-level graphic resource inside an extension action.
summaryOverrides.encodeChannels: Atomically replaces multiple compatible encoding channels on one explicit mark from one final state.
summaryOverrides.applyDataUpdate: Apply prepared source or parameter data to the exact immutable base with the current host token.

filterData.error: The where predicate is combined with field filter options, or a field mode is missing.
filterData.fix: Supply only where, or supply field and exactly one of oneOf, noneOf, predicate, or range.

encodeAngle.error: Both value and field are supplied.
encodeAngle.fix: Choose a constant angle or a quantitative field, not both.

createHeatmap.error: Raw rows are requested without a bin object or pre-gridded rows omit color.
createHeatmap.fix: Use bin for raw x/y rows, or provide x, y, and color for pre-gridded rows.

removeEncoding.error: The selected channel is not assigned to the target mark.
removeEncoding.fix: Pass a currently assigned channel and disambiguate target when needed.

createDerivedData.error: transform is empty or contains more than one transform.
createDerivedData.fix: Provide exactly one valid DatasetTransform object.

editSemantic.fix: Use either { property, value } or { property, remove: true }.

editGraphics.error: A removal also supplies property or value.
editGraphics.fix: Use either { target, property, value } or { target, remove: true }.

editXOffsetScale.error: The target has no xOffset scale.
editXOffsetScale.fix: Encode a categorical xOffset on that mark before editing its nested scale.

editXOffsetScale.error: range, type, or order is supplied.
editXOffsetScale.fix: Use domain for subgroup order; the parent category slot owns the concrete range and the scale type is ordinal.

editYOffsetScale.error: The target has no yOffset scale.
editYOffsetScale.fix: Encode a categorical yOffset on that mark before editing its nested scale.

editYOffsetScale.error: range, type, or order is supplied.
editYOffsetScale.fix: Use domain for subgroup order; the parent category slot owns the concrete range and the scale type is ordinal.

applyDataUpdate.error: A copied handle, changed receiver or stale request token cannot be applied.
applyDataUpdate.fix: Prepare against the latest program and pass the unchanged handle with the current host token.
Use the default entry point for prepared revisions and parameter updates.
